channel.title: Men Without a Map
channel.description: Last 10 notes on Men Without a Map

item.title: Chosen, Not Needed — On Being Wanted With Full Agency
item.description: Chosen, Not Needed — On Being Wanted With Full Agency Patriarchy teaches men that their worth is transactional: you are kept because you are useful.

item.title: Confession vs. Witness in Personal Writing
item.description: Confession vs. Witness in Personal Writing There are two distinct modes of personal writing. Both involve real experience.

item.title: Dissolution — The Self Beyond the Performance
item.description: Dissolution — The Self Beyond the Performance Dissolution is what men fear most in the presence of feminine sovereignty, and what they most misunderstand.

item.title: Ecological Hierarchy — Primacy Without Dominance
item.description: Ecological Hierarchy — Primacy Without Dominance Patriarchy operates through a single kind of hierarchy: vertical, competitive, ranked by power-over.

item.title: Eros Captured — When Life Force Becomes Extraction
item.description: Eros Captured — When Life Force Becomes Extraction The erotic drive in men has a function.

item.title: Feminine Fury as Sovereign Expression
item.description: Feminine Fury as Sovereign Expression Society has a narrow tolerance for women’s emotional range.

item.title: Hollywood and the Borrowed Moment
item.description: Hollywood and the Borrowed Moment Hollywood has a consistent pattern: women are allowed access to power, but their residency in it is carefully managed.

item.title: The Belonging Loop — From Void to Control
item.description: The Belonging Loop — From Void to Control This is the mechanism by which the core wound produces patriarchal behavior.

item.title: The Benevolent Patriarch — Love as Justification for Control
item.description: The Benevolent Patriarch — Love as Justification for Control The most seductive form of patriarchal control does not present itself as control.

item.title: The Four Ancient Fears of Female Sovereignty
item.description: The Four Ancient Fears of Female Sovereignty The suppression of women’s power is not merely a social or political phenomenon.
